title: metric-sampler / Attention
description: Attention statistics of every softmax (MLA) and linear (GDN) layer, exact over every rank, microbatch and row: means are sums over the counted rows divided by the rows, minima and maxima are over every row. The trends and heatmaps use the training step as seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC because Grafana plots a time axis; read 00:05:00 as step 300.

list.name: exp
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.batches GROUP BY exp ORDER BY exp = (SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE exp = '${exp}' GROUP BY run ORDER BY run = (SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' AND exp = '${exp}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: capture_interval
list.label: capture_interval
list.query: SELECT greatest(max(capture_interval), 1) FROM metric_sampler.node_manifests WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}'

list.name: layer
list.label: Layer
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT layer FROM metric_sampler.router_vectors WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND layer <= 255 AND metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metric_sampler.metrics WHERE name = if('${kind}' = 'softmax', 'attn/softmax/lse_stats', 'attn/linear/norm_stats')) AND step >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') - 200 ORDER BY layer

list.name: head
list.label: Head
list.query: SELECT arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(max(intDiv(length(`values`) - 1, 3))))) AS head FROM metric_sampler.router_vectors WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND layer = toInt32OrNull(${layer:sqlstring}) AND metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metric_sampler.metrics WHERE name = if('${kind}' = 'softmax', 'attn/softmax/lse_stats', 'attn/linear/norm_stats')) AND step >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') - 5

list.name: rank
list.label: Rank
list.query: SELECT '-2' AS __value, 'All (aggregate)' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT toString(v) AS __value, if(v = -1, 'Legacy aggregate (not separable)', toString(v)) AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT rank AS v FROM metric_sampler.scalars WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metric_sampler.metrics WHERE name = 'loss/total') ORDER BY v)

list.name: microbatch
list.label: Microbatch
list.query: SELECT '-2' AS __value, 'All (aggregate)' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT toString(v) AS __value, if(v = -1, 'Legacy aggregate (not separable)', toString(v)) AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT microbatch AS v FROM metric_sampler.scalars WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metric_sampler.metrics WHERE name = 'loss/total') ORDER BY v)

list.name: asrc
list.label: asrc
list.query: SELECT if(ifNull(toInt32OrNull(${rank:sqlstring}), -3) = -2 AND ifNull(toInt32OrNull(${microbatch:sqlstring}), -3) = -2 AND (SELECT count() = 3 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('attention_softmax', 'attention_linear', 'attention_entropy_hist') GROUP BY summary)), 'all', 'live') AS asrc

list.name: rsrc
list.label: rsrc
list.query: SELECT if(ifNull(toInt32OrNull(${microbatch:sqlstring}), -3) = -2 AND (SELECT count() = 1 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('attention_rank') GROUP BY summary)), 'all', 'live') AS rsrc

list.name: latest_step
list.label: latest_step
list.query: SELECT if('${asrc}' = 'all', greatest((SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.summary_attention_softmax WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND head = -1 AND step <= (SELECT step_limit FROM metric_sampler.latest_step_limit(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}'))), (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.summary_attention_linear WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND head = -1 AND step <= (SELECT step_limit FROM metric_sampler.latest_step_limit(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}')))), (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND step <= (SELECT step_limit FROM metric_sampler.latest_step_limit(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}'))))

list.name: remember
list.label: Remembered selection
list.query: SELECT '' AS remembered SETTINGS log_comment = 'ms-selection ${__user.login} ${exp} ${run}', use_query_cache = 0
